finding.title: TokenAuthenticator#valid_token accepts an expired API token.
finding.description: TokenAuthenticator#valid_token accepts an expired API token. Locate the token validation in lib/token_authenticator.rb.

source_files.content:
require_relative "../../lib/token_authenticator"

class ApiController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate

  private

  def authenticate
    auth = TokenAuthenticator.new(secret: ENV.fetch("API_SECRET"))
    head :unauthorized unless auth.valid_token(request.headers["X-Api-Token"])
  end
end
